thread:
maya_cs: FYI customer (ACME) just reported a clear quality regression after our latest quantization rollout. They said generated product descriptions are missing brand-specific attributes and contain hallucinated specs. sending samples below.

maya_cs: Customer reported after we flipped the quant_profile to `int8-aggressive-v1` at ~1744999800. They did canary traffic then saw full rollout 100% at ~1744999900 (deploy-bot posted).

maya_cs: Sample prompt (they pasted):
```
Prompt: 
"Write a 2-sentence product description for the Acme X2000 smart oven. Include 2 key features and call out warranty info."
```

maya_cs: Response BEFORE (FP16 / previous profile):
```
The Acme X2000 smart oven delivers precise temperature control and rapid preheat times. Key features: multi-zone convection and Wi-Fi recipe sync; includes a 2-year limited warranty covering parts and labor.
```

maya_cs: Response AFTER (INT8 aggressive):
```
The X2000 cooks fast and has smart modes. Key features: multi-mode and network support; warranty varies.
```

maya_cs: Customer: "We lost the explicit warranty mention and the feature names are vague now. Output is noticeably shorter and less factual on multiple prompts." They attached 7 more examples, some with hallucinated battery specs (this oven doesn't have a battery).

javier_ml: Can you attach the exact request payload and the model + profile that served it? Need to reproduce locally. Also which region and whether caching/batching was on.

maya_cs: Pasted payload (sanitized):
```json
{"model":"redwood-13b-v2","quant_profile":"int8-aggressive-v1","input":"Write a 2-sentence product description...","max_tokens":120,"temperature":0.2}
```

maya_cs: Region eu-west-1, no prefix cache set on customer, they call single-shot API, batching probably disabled for these short requests.

emily_research: This smells like calibration/scale mismatch in the INT8 profile. We've seen reduced token-level confidence leading to shorter outputs and more conservative phrasing if the quant table clips certain logits. Do we have the quantization calibration logs for that profile?

sam_infra: Deploy logs show the quant-profile was applied by rollout job `rollout/quant-1744999` - snippet: 
```
[1744999888] rollout/quant-1744999: applying profile int8-aggressive-v1 -> redwood-13b-v2 (canary 10%)
[1744999899] deploy-bot: canary pass
[1744999905] rollout: expanding to 100%
[1744999912] runtime: kernel fast-matmul-v3 enabled on nodes g4dn-16xlarge
```

sam_infra: Also note driver bump to cuda 12.2 on that cluster earlier in the day; kernel selection changed. Could be interaction between kernel and quant path.

javier_ml: Good catch. Two axes: the quant-profile itself (scale/zero-point choices) and the runtime kernels. Steps to repro: run inference with exact same model artifact and quant tables on a node with previous kernel/drivers and with the new kernel. We should also run the model under FP16 as a control.

leah_support: Customer is on paid enterprise plan and flagged this as P1 for them (loss of core product copy). They want mitigation asap. Can we provide a rollback option and a temporary mitigation message to send?

emily_research: Mitigation options in order: 1) roll back profile to previous `int8-stable-v0` (or fall back to FP16 if needed) per-customer via routing policy; 2) run quick calibration with expanded dataset from their domain; 3) tweak clip thresholds in quant table. Rolling back is fastest.

deploy-bot: [1744999905] rollout/quant-1744999 -> completed: redwood-13b-v2 @ 100% (int8-aggressive-v1).

sam_infra: I can prepare a targeted rollback for that model and region. Need approval to push rollback to 1744999750-profile (the previous profile id). ETA ~15-25m if no conflicts. Will also pin kernel selection to `fast-matmul-v2` for that node pool.

javier_ml: Before rollback, capture a reproducible test set from the customer examples (they provided 8). I'll run the eval harness: compare token-level distributions, entropy, and top-k probabilities FP16 vs INT8. If we see systematic probability compression, we'll know it's quant table related.

maya_cs: Uploaded customer's 8 prompts + expected highlights to the shared drive and gave access to javier/emily. Customer patch note they added in thread: "Please flag when it's fixed, we halted new product copy generation."

leah_support: I'll notify the customer that we're investigating and planning a rollback in ~20m and offer a temporary manual review workflow. Sending standard P1 playbook now.

emily_research: Also request infra to preserve the canary nodes (snapshot) so we can run bit-exact comparisons. Sam, can you create snapshots and preserve the quant tables used in that rollout?

sam_infra: Creating snapshots now and archiving `/deployments/rollout/quant-1744999/` (including quant tables and kernel flags). Link: https://internal.storage/snapshots/quant-1744999 (internal only).

javier_ml: Running eval locally now. Will post diff summary. If we confirm quality drop tied to int8-aggressive-v1, propose immediate rollback and a gated re-release after calibration.

maya_cs: THANKS. @leah_support pls keep customer updated. I'll be on the call if they want a joint sync. :thumbsup:

javier_ml: Quick interim result: token entropy drops ~18% on average across their prompts under int8-aggressive-v1 vs FP16; top-1 probability increase for generic tokens. That explains shorter, more generic outputs.

emily_research: Confirmed — calibration loss. Recommend rollback now.

sam_infra: Rolling back to `int8-stable-v0` for redwood-13b-v2 in eu-west-1 now. I'll also pin kernel to `fast-matmul-v2` for that pool.

deploy-bot: [1745000100] rollout/quant-rollback-17450001 started: target redwood-13b-v2 -> int8-stable-v0 (selective region eu-west-1).

sam_infra: Rollback complete.

deploy-bot: [1745000180] rollout/quant-rollback-17450001 completed: redwood-13b-v2 @ 100% (int8-stable-v0) in eu-west-1.

javier_ml: Re-ran eval on the preserved test set against snapshot nodes. Entropy and top-k distributions match FP16 much more closely now. Sample outputs look aligned with previous behavior.

maya_cs: I'll send a status update to the customer: explain issue, say we rolled back the quant profile and are running further calibration tests. Offer to re-run their batch through FP16 for 24h while we tune.

leah_support: Customer escalated thanks and wants a postmortem + timeline for a safe re-release. I'll schedule follow-up with research+infra+cs. Action items:
- emily_research: produce calibration plan and test harness changes (due +3d)
- javier_ml: extend regression tests and add entropy checks to CI (due +2d)
- sam_infra: add pre-rollout kernel compatibility checks and snapshot hooks (due +1d)
- maya_cs/leah_support: draft customer-facing incident summary and mitigation notes (due +1d)

maya_cs: I'll draft the summary once javier/emily post their findings. Thanks team.

javier_ml: Posting final short note: confirmed quant-profile `int8-aggressive-v1` is the root cause; rollback successful. Will follow up with calibration run recommendations. :white_check_mark:
